system.description:
FLOURISH SHAMAN SPIRIT

Your guide briefly extends part of its presence around another creature.
Action 1 AP
Requirements Manifest Spirit is currently active.
Select one willing ally within 30 feet. Until the beginning of your next turn, that ally gains one benefit from your currently active Manifestation:
Ancestor: Advantage on Recall Knowledge or Sense Motive checks.
Beast: +10 feet Speed.
Elemental: Resistance to your selected elemental damage type.
Land: +1 Base DR.
Veil: Resistance to Essence damage.

Prerequisites Level 13, Manifest Spirit

Use (1 AP; target the ally) while Manifest Spirit is active: the guide's shared benefit lands on them as a one-round effect.
